features.description: Add Visitors Analytics, publish your site and you're set. You'll see all your stats in your dashboard.
features.name: Get Started Easily

features.description: See where visitors come from, who's live on your site right now, what days you get the most traffic and more.
features.name: View All Your Stats

features.description: Easy to follow charts and graphs make viewing all your stats a breeze.
features.name: Track Everything at a Glance

features.description: Find out more about your visitors like the browsers they use, their operating systems, IP addresses, etc.
features.name: Get Advanced Insights

features.description: Proudly display how many visitors you get with a traffic counter on your site.
features.name: Show Off Your Visits

features.description: Get an overview of your important stats right to your inbox. Set the frequency - daily, weekly or monthly, then sit back and enjoy.
features.name: Set Email Notifications

features.description: Visitor Analytics' click path graphs show you how visitors navigate your site, so you can better optimize your content.
features.name: Find Out Where Visitors Go

features.description: Quickly export your stats to Excel, so you can save them to a datasheet for offline use.
features.name: Easily Export Your Data

features.description: Visitor Analytics puts your traffic on the map, so you can easily pinpoint the country and city where each visitor comes from.
features.name: Map Your Visitors

features.description: Exclude your own site visits from the data, so your stats are as accurate as can be.
features.name: Filter Your Site Visits

features.description: Get access to detailed information for all your visitors. without being limited to 1000 page visits per month.
features.name: Unlimited Stats
